title: 希望大家能多给一些时间  (Asking Everyone for a Little More Time)

segments.t: As Bianbian's entertainment broadcast details triple-damages claims, stalled listing plans, and boardroom turmoil at Xingtian, PR director Stella steps before the press microphones—right before Xingtian's overseas deal is suspended for review. Listen to Bianbian and Stella in Mandarin first.
据悉，诉讼包括歌曲利润所得三倍以上的天价索赔，以及星天娱乐公开道歉。
星天娱乐一直是备受投资界关注的明星企业，公司估值一度突破百亿。
此次严重侵权事件恐将打击星天信誉价值，实际造成的损失尚不可预期。
已有行业分析师论断，此事必将造成星天娱乐股权整合及上市进程大幅拖慢。
由此引发的股东内部分歧与高管层问责风暴，可能是比侵权本身更为严重的企业危机。
关于此次我公司的侵权事件，表示非常抱歉。
我们也会尽快地找出事情的缘由，然后给大家一个说法。
另外，我们现在也在尽量去找歌曲作者本人。
希望大家能多给一些时间。
与星天的战略合作被总部收回重审，消息已经公布了。
请再给我们二十四个小时的时间。
董事会已经要求召开董事大会问责。
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
据悉，诉讼包括歌曲利润所得三倍以上的天价索赔，以及星天娱乐公开道歉。
'Reports say the lawsuit demands triple-profit damages along with a formal public apology from Xingtian Entertainment.'
星天娱乐一直是备受投资界关注的明星企业，公司估值一度突破百亿。
'Xingtian Entertainment has long been a star company watched closely by investors, with its valuation once topping ten billion.'
此次严重侵权事件恐将打击星天信誉价值，实际造成的损失尚不可预期。
'This serious infringement case threatens Xingtian's reputation, and the full financial losses remain unpredictable.'
已有行业分析师论断，此事必将造成星天娱乐股权整合及上市进程大幅拖慢。
'Industry analysts warn the lawsuit will severely delay Xingtian's share restructuring and public listing.'
由此引发的股东内部分歧与高管层问责风暴，可能是比侵权本身更为严重的企业危机。
'The resulting shareholder rifts and executive accountability storm may prove even deadlier than the lawsuit itself.'
关于此次我公司的侵权事件，表示非常抱歉。
'Regarding our company's copyright incident, we express our deepest apologies.'
我们也会尽快地找出事情的缘由，然后给大家一个说法。
'We will get to the bottom of how this happened as quickly as possible and give the public a clear answer.'
另外，我们现在也在尽量去找歌曲作者本人。
'In addition, we are doing everything we can to reach the song's original author in person.'
希望大家能多给一些时间。
'We sincerely ask everyone to grant us a little more time.'
与星天的战略合作被总部收回重审，消息已经公布了。
'Meanwhile, the overseas group's headquarters has pulled the strategic partnership back for review and announced the freeze.'
请再给我们二十四个小时的时间。
'Please allow us twenty-four hours to verify the facts.'
董事会已经要求召开董事大会问责。
'And Xingtian's board has demanded an emergency board meeting to assign blame.'
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

Asking reporters for time to find the song's original lyricist-composer, Stella tries to buy breathing room while boardroom rivals demand Chun Yuqiao's head. See you next time!
